question:
Performance of 1800 students in grades has been shown in the following pie chart.

The number of students getting grade B is what percentage of the number of students getting grade A?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6064d81262d030d5f6d306efb2c45dc08fc68b012add0b9417e4fdef4197855.png]
solution:
**Given:**

The number of students getting grade B is 27%

The number of students getting grade A is 30%

**Formula used:**

Percentage = (given value/comparession value)× 100
